title: A GIF card's pixelDimensions describe the FRAME STORE, not the built .gif — the size label lies whenever longest edge caps it
description: Fabio set longest edge 1024, the built file really is 1024x426 on disk, and the history card still read 1536x640 (2026-09-20). routes/gif.js stamps pixelDimensions from frameDimensions(frames[0].hash) — the frame-store canvas — on both the update and new paths, two lines after buildGif() wrote a file scaled to output.maxEdge. gifCutout, gifMake and gifTransform (two callers through _writeNewGifCard) all do the same with a pre-build target. gifMaker.js:251 is the one that already measures the built file; that is the pattern. Root fix is one helper used at every buildGif card-writing site.
